plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for Ruckus wireless device. It reports uptime, CPU utilization, memory utilization, interface traffic, and associated/registered/licensed AP and client counts via scalar GET (RUCKUS-SYSTEM and ZoneDirector scalars, enterprise PEN 25053).
name: Wireless

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the wireless controller since the last restart, derived from sysUpTime. Monitoring uptime helps administrators understand device stability and identify unexpected reboots.

metrics.name: device_cpu_usage
metrics.description: CPU utilization of the Ruckus platform, reported directly as a 0-100 percentage from the ZoneDirector ruckusZDSystemCPUUtil scalar (1.3.6.1.4.1.25053.1.2.1.1.1.15.13.0), falling back to RUCKUS-SYSTEM ruckusSystemCPUUtil (1.3.6.1.4.1.25053.1.1.11.1.1.1.1.0) when the former is absent or out of range. Sustained high CPU usage can indicate heavy client-association load or control-plane pressure affecting roaming and management responsiveness.

metrics.name: device_memory_usage
metrics.description: Memory utilization of the Ruckus platform, reported directly as a 0-100 percentage from the ZoneDirector ruckusZDSystemMemoryUtil scalar (1.3.6.1.4.1.25053.1.2.1.1.1.15.14.0), falling back to RUCKUS-SYSTEM ruckusSystemMemoryUtil (1.3.6.1.4.1.25053.1.1.11.1.1.1.2.0) when the former is absent or out of range. High memory pressure can cause the controller to drop client associations or restart services.

metrics.name: wireless_ap_count
metrics.description: Number of access points associated with the ZoneDirector controller (ruckusZDSystemNumAP). A sudden drop can indicate AP connectivity loss or a controller failover.

metrics.name: wireless_registered_ap_count
metrics.description: Number of access points currently registered with the ZoneDirector controller (ruckusZDSystemNumRegisteredAP). Compare with associated and licensed AP counts to spot registration gaps.

metrics.name: wireless_client_count
metrics.description: Number of wireless client stations currently associated through the ZoneDirector controller (ruckusZDSystemNumSta). Rapid growth can correlate with CPU and memory pressure on the controller.

metrics.name: wireless_licensed_ap_count
metrics.description: Number of access points licensed on the ZoneDirector controller (ruckusZDSystemLicensedAPs). When associated APs approach this limit, additional licenses may be required.
